familySummary: Swan armchairs combine a distinctive lounge-chair profile with fabric upholstery and comfort foam, in beige and brown colour combinations.
familyDescription: A Swan armchair creates a separate place to sit in the living room or bedroom. The range uses fabric, foam and wood, with beige and brown tones across the available options.
